newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait aviation workers to delay flights over pay.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait aviation workers to delay flights over pay.

text.p: The Kuwait aviation workers union plans to delay all flights from the Gulf state by one hour next week to press the state-owned Kuwait Airways Corp (KAC) to improve wages, a newspaper said on Saturday.
"The society of Kuwaiti pilots and flight engineers decided yesterday (Friday) to delay all flights from Kuwait airport for an hour," said al-Rai al-Aam newspaper.
The delays would begin at 6:00 a.m. (0300 GMT) on Wednesday and continue until 8:30 a.m. (0530 GMT) on Sunday, it said.

The delays were "a protest measure that the union threatened to develop into a firmer measure", the paper said. "It could become a work stoppage if it did not succeed in making KAC fulfill the demands of the society's members."
The society wants a review of basic salaries, overtime payments, special allowances and housing, the paper said.
KAC and society officials were not available for comment, but an industry source said talks between both sides were underway to resolve the dispute.
